prompt: Repaint this photo as an oil portrait on poplar panel by Leonardo da Vinci, in the manner of the Mona Lisa (1503–1519). Model each person's real face with sfumato: soft, smoky transitions from warm light into deep shadow, without hard edges, in warm muted browns, olive greens and amber. Keep their own pose and hand positions, hairstyle and hair colour; clothing becomes simple dark Renaissance garments of velvet and finely pleated linen, following the shape of their own clothes. Behind them lies a hazy blue-green imaginary landscape with winding paths, a small bridge and distant water, seen from a slightly higher vantage point. The whole surface shows old yellowed varnish and fine craquelure. The face itself shows brushwork, varnish and craquelure like the rest of the panel.
